title: Enhancement: PDDF SPI support
author: domingo-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Support for SPI controller and SPI devices via PDDF

### Current Behavior

Currently, PDDF does not support creation or deletion of SPI controllers / SPI devices. SPI controllers and SPI devices cannot be registered / removed in user space.

### Proposed Behavior

Enable definition of SPI controllers and associated SPI devices in PDDF. Example usage could be `pddfparse.py --create-subtree <spi_device_name>` and `pddfparse.py --delete-subtree <spi_device_name>`

linkedPullRequests.title: Add PDDF SPI support
linkedPullRequests.author: domingo-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it


Recommend to review each commit individually:
- [`Create pddf module for creating and deleting SPI controller and SPI devices`](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26550/changes/2c3395a0184031538c295411e04b250d74f2d84f) - main change adding support for SPI controllers and SPI devices in PDDF
- [`Refactor pcie_variable config to its directory`](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/26550/changes/788a5d2b5df30bac7fc57803b352d7bcd1b89dc5) - Refactor nexthop's pcie_variable config and make platform string detection more reliable (which will be used in pddf json for defining platform SPI controllers and devices)

- Add PDDF SPI support for defining SPI controllers and associated SPI devices in PDDF, to enable multiple SPI controllers and multiple SPI devices per controller
- A SPI device can also be marked persistent, which is asserted as long as the SPI controller is present. Otherwise, user or toolings would need to create and delete the SPI device on demand (`pddfparse.py --create-subtree SPI_DEVICE_NAME` `pddfparse.py --delete-subtree SPI_DEVICE_NAME`)
- Do not `pci_request_regions()` (and `pci_release_regions()`) This allows child device drivers (like spi-xilinx) to claim "sub-regions" within the PCI BAR

Changes to platform's pddf-device.json will be in a separate PR.

Resolves https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/26133

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

- pddf create SPI controllers automatically and associated SPI devices if they are marked persistent
- Create/delete SPI controller and associated SPI devices in `pddfparse`
- Add CLI and reusable libraries for centralized way of retrieving information about SPI devices

#### How to verify it

Add a SPI controller and associated SPI device to pddf-device.json for testing.

```
$ sudo pddfparse.py --create-subtree SWITCHCARD_CONFIG_FLASH

INFO: [__init__:40] loading device JSON from /usr/share/sonic/platform/pddf/pddf-device.json
INFO: [__init__:43] device JSON loaded successfully
INFO: [__init__:52] initialization completed
success
success

$ ls /sys/bus/spi/devices/
spi1.0

$ sudo mtd_debug info /dev/mtd0
mtd.type = MTD_NORFLASH
mtd.flags = MTD_CAP_NORFLASH
mtd.size = 33554432 (32M)
mtd.erasesize = 65536 (64K)
mtd.writesize = 1
mtd.oobsize = 0
regions = 0

$ sudo pddfparse.py --delete-subtree SWITCHCARD_CONFIG_FLASH
INFO: [__init__:32] initialization started
INFO: [__init__:40] loading device JSON from /usr/share/sonic/platform/pddf/pddf-device.json
INFO: [__init__:43] device JSON loaded successfully
INFO: [__init__:52] initialization completed
success

$ ls /sys/bus/spi/devices/

```
